# Millionærklubben Eksklusiv: Sådan tænker den professionelle investor – gode tips og tricks til at finde attraktive aktier Del 1

**Feed**: millionaerklubben  
**Published**: 2026-09-24  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This is part 1 of a live Millionærklubben panel (Euroinvestor, Danish) with Nykredit chief strategist Frederik Engholm, Otto Mønsted director Nina Movin and H.C. Andersen Capital head of equities Michael (Friksjørnsen). Broadly they are constructive: US and European growth looks resilient despite low consumer confidence, the AI investment boom is running in its own gear, and the US–Greenland deal lowers the tail risk for Denmark. The main worries are the credit market (all growth is debt-financed, plus private equity exit bottlenecks and US Treasury intervention in bond markets), possible central bank over-tightening from energy-driven inflation, and European political risk. Company talk is mostly anecdotal: Novo Nordisk's post-capital-markets-day drop, Greenland banks as a way to play Greenland growth, and pressure on consumer names like Nike and Puma.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟡 NOVO-B — Novo Nordisk | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Nina still holds a sizeable Novo position despite the sharp drop; disappointed by the CMD and expects recovery to take time.

#### Reasoning

Guest Nina Movin (Otto Mønsted) is keeping her remaining Novo stake and is following it closely. She calls the capital markets day and what came after disappointing and says a turnaround 'will take time'. This is reluctant holding, not added conviction. Frederik (Nykredit) adds that Danish investors should avoid being concentrated in Novo/DSV.

#### Sell Triggers

- further disappointing guidance after the capital markets day
- US trade restrictions on Danish pharma exports
- continued share price deterioration

> *"Vi har stadigvæk en del tilbage, og jeg synes, det er rigtig vigtigt. Og det kommer til at tage tid, men jeg havde håbet på en bedre... Altså, jeg synes, det var trist med den der kapitalmarkedsdag."*

---

### 🟠 GRLA — Grønlandsbanken | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Michael: US–Greenland deal should bring investment and growth, which tends to flow into local banks; names Grønlandsbanken.

#### Reasoning

Guest Michael (H.C. Andersen Capital) argues US investment in Greenland will lift growth, and when you invest in a growing economy you usually end up buying its banks. He calls Greenland a tiny, illiquid part of the market and warns against everyone crowding in, so this is a speculative theme rather than a firm recommendation.

#### Sell Triggers

- US–Greenland agreement fails to translate into actual investment
- Trump changes stance on Greenland
- liquidity constraints

> *"Så der kommer øget økonomisk vækst i år, derfor lav, nævner Grønlandsbanken."*
